source: web/lib via harness/out (tenancy, plans, renewal, ledger, tax) — G5 shared truth tables

resolver.title: uid == businessId ⇒ owner, before every other leg
membership without a role ⇒ manager (legacy default)
membership but email REMOVED from the mirror ⇒ no access (removal cuts both legs)
no membership; staffIndex at this business + mirror ⇒ legacy role
staffIndex points at ANOTHER business ⇒ no access here (cross-business isolation)
staffIndex at this business but email removed from mirror ⇒ no access
caller email is trimmed + lowercased before the mirror test
both legs present ⇒ membership wins over legacy

claims.title: pending invite for the caller's verified email ⇒ membership + claim + index + event
invite is for a different email ⇒ refused
invite claimed by someone else ⇒ refused
own claim + membership present ⇒ ok, zero writes
own claim but membership gone ⇒ already-claimed (the claim is spent)
invite in a non-pending, non-claimed state ⇒ refused

backfill.title: legacy staffer, no membership ⇒ mirror write plan (source staff)

index.title: healIndex: dead entries drop, roles refresh from live docs, dupes collapse
indexWith: an existing entry is replaced (role refreshed) and moves last
buildSwitcherList: own first, memberships in name order, own never duplicated

snapshots.title: trialPlanSnapshot: 14 days, 2 users, 200 pool, Standard set
foundingPlanSnapshot: Advanced set + limits, no expiry
snapshotFor basic with an admin period end
snapshotFor enterprise: catalogue nulls store as 0 (= unlimited)
snapshotFor enterprise with pinned limits (null invoice limit ⇒ 0)
snapshotFor trial re-derives the trial end and nulls the period

planState.title: no registry ⇒ none (pre-G shop; nothing gates)
trial: 1ms before the end instant is still trial
trial: the end instant itself still belongs to the trial
trial: end + 30 days exactly ⇒ still grace (inclusive)
paid: the end instant itself is still active
a paid-shaped snapshot without dates reads active (never bricks a shop)

gates.title: no registry: state none, nothing refused, counters read 0
active + enforce, counter AT the limit ⇒ the next event refuses: invoice-cap
active + enforce, one below the limit ⇒ postable, projected count = limit
trial + enforce, pool exhausted ⇒ invoice-cap (the pool is the limit)
trial + enforce: the projected count accumulates across the month edge (no roll)

counters.title: a new PKT month (Oct 31 19:00Z = Nov 1 PKT) rolls to 1
trial NEVER rolls — the pool accumulates across the edge

actuals.title: monthly reading: held bills, bill rows, returns and other PKT months excluded
trial reading: the pool consumed since periodFrom (month edges ignored)

quotes.title: renew early: the new period starts at the CURRENT period's end (nothing bought is lost)
renew from grace: the period starts NOW
from trial: the period starts at the trial's end
an enterprise business renews by console conversation
enterprise is not purchasable from the surface
trial is a birth state, not purchasable
a dateless paid snapshot renews from now

submissions.title: the record is born submitted, in the owner's name, amount from the catalogue
a non-blank owner note rides; the amount follows an annual quote
submission stays open while SUSPENDED (the remedy must reach it)
actor ≠ business ⇒ refused (a member cannot submit the owner's renewal)
a blank reference refuses (nothing to check against the bank)

lifecycle.title: trial with > 7 days left: plain countdown + pool figures
the last hour of grace: elapsed floors, left ceils to 1
